description: Implement SourceIntelligence for multi-provider data merging and conflict detection, plus comprehensive test coverage
steps: 1. Create backend/app/providers/source_intelligence.py with SourceIntelligence class. Synchronous class (no async) that works with ProviderMatchStats objects.

2. Implement merge_statistics(self, stats_list: List[ProviderMatchStats], strategy: str = 'first') -> Optional[ProviderMatchStats]. Three strategies: 'first' (first non-None value per field wins), 'most_complete' (provider with most non-None fields wins entirely, not field-by-field), 'highest_quality' (use DataQualityEngine.check_completeness and DataQualityEngine.check_consistency to score each ProviderMatchStats, pick highest). Return None if stats_list is empty.

3. Implement detect_conflicts(self, stats_list: List[ProviderMatchStats]) -> Dict[str, List[Dict]]. For each field, check if providers disagree. Return {field_name: [{'provider': str, 'value': Any}, ...]} only for fields where values differ across providers (excluding None values).

4. Implement get_field_sources(self, merged_stats: ProviderMatchStats, stats_list: List[ProviderMatchStats]) -> Dict[str, str]. For each non-None field in merged_stats, find which provider in stats_list supplied that value. Return {field_name: provider_name}.
5. Update backend/app/providers/__init__.py: add 'from app.providers.source_intelligence import SourceIntelligence' and add 'SourceIntelligence' to __all__ list.

6. Create backend/tests/test_sofascore_provider.py. Test structure following backend/tests/test_api_matches.py pattern (pytest with fixtures). Tests: test_sofascore_provider_initialization, test_normalize_match_statistics_maps_all_fields, test_normalize_match_statistics_handles_missing_fields, test_normalize_match_statistics_sets_period_field, test_get_match_statistics_returns_tuple, test_get_match_caches_result, test_parse_match_status_handles_all_statuses, test_provider_exports. Use httpx-mock or unittest.mock.patch to mock HTTP requests - DO NOT make real API calls.

7. Create backend/tests/test_data_quality.py. Test structure following pytest pattern. Tests: test_check_completeness_all_fields_present, test_check_completeness_missing_fields, test_check_consistency_valid_stats, test_check_consistency_shots_violation, test_check_consistency_possession_violation, test_check_consistency_negative_values, test_check_freshness_recent_data, test_check_freshness_stale_data, test_detect_source_conflicts_no_conflicts, test_detect_source_conflicts_with_disagreement, test_calculate_quality_score_perfect, test_calculate_quality_score_incomplete, test_calculate_quality_score_inconsistent, test_quality_score_formula_deterministic.

8. Create backend/tests/test_source_intelligence.py. Test structure following pytest pattern. Tests: test_merge_statistics_first_strategy, test_merge_statistics_most_complete_strategy, test_merge_statistics_highest_quality_strategy, test_merge_statistics_empty_list, test_detect_conflicts_no_conflicts, test_detect_conflicts_with_disagreements, test_detect_conflicts_ignores_none_values, test_get_field_sources_tracks_origin, test_get_field_sources_all_fields.
9. Run all tests including new ones. Verify 38 existing tests + new tests all pass. Fix any failures by correcting the implementation, not by modifying tests.
